bio: Why not try an original Afternoon Tea at Terra a Terre? This double AA Rosette winning restaurant have continued their creative approach to vegetarian cuisine in developing a unique Afternoon Tea menu.  Afternoon Tea is served in the main restaurant, which provides a welcoming atmosphere where guests can relax and enjoy a selection of quality produced food.  They serve a Vegetarian, Vegan and Gluten Free Afternoon Tea, which consists of one savoury tier followed by three tiers of sweet treats featuring innovative dishes that tantalise all the senses. If you are feeling in an indulgent mood you can upgrade to include a glass of fizz or a cocktail.  This restaurant is located just a three-minute walk from Brighton Pier, not too far from Brighton Sea Life Centre.
